libraries.theFoldersArcLooks: Add and manage your movie, TV and other video libraries.
libraries.addAFolderOf: Add a movie, TV or other video library to get started.
libraries.aBackupIsMade: A backup is made first, so you can undo this from Backups.
libraries.scanRequestedSeeActivity: Scan requested. See Activity for results.
libraries.scanFailed_one: {{count}} library could not start. Retry below.
libraries.scanFailed_other: {{count}} libraries could not start. Retry below.
libraries.removeShows: Arc forgets everything about this library: its shows, episode orders and anything you've edited. Your files aren't touched, and you can add the folders again at any time.
libraries.removeVideos: Arc forgets everything about this library: its videos and anything you've edited. Your files aren't touched, and you can add the folders again at any time.
libraries.removeMovies: Arc forgets everything about this library: its movies and anything you've edited. Your files aren't touched, and you can add the folders again at any time.
libraries.scanError: The scan could not be requested. Try again.
libraries.addedNotice: {{name}} is added. Arc is now finding and matching its media in the background, and titles appear as they're found. The Activity icon beside the notifications bell shows progress and anything that needs attention.

health.anythingInYourLibraries: Review matching problems, unreadable or missing files, episode ordering and skip-marker coverage. Arc never changes your media files.
health.everyFileWasRead: No matching, file or episode-ordering issues were reported by the latest library checks.
health.arcCouldnTFind: These titles have not been matched to an online provider. Available files are still playable; use Identify to choose a match.
health.theseFilesMayBe: Arc could not inspect these files. They may be damaged, incomplete or unavailable. Check the error and scan again; repeated failures may wait before retrying.
health.arcReadsTheSeason: Arc reads the season and episode from the file name, like “Show - S01E02”. Rename these and scan again to add them.
health.arcCouldnTTell: Arc couldn’t tell what these files are.
health.theseFilesWerenT: These files were not found in the latest scan. Reconnect unavailable drives and scan again. Records and watch history are kept until you remove them or automatic trash cleanup runs.
health.severalCopiesOfThe: Several copies of the same title. That can be on purpose, like a 4K and a 1080p version.
health.episodesThatHaveAired: Episodes that have aired but aren't in your library, in the episode order you chose for each show. Specials aren't counted.
health.notInTheChosen: Not in the chosen episode order
health.youHaveTheseEpisodes: You have these episodes, but the episode order picked for the show doesn't include them. They're listed separately on the show's page so nothing goes missing.
health.theFileSEpisode: The file's episode number isn't in the show's episode list. It's still playable on the show's page.
health.showNoMatchOn: Show · no match on TheTVDB or TMDB
health.duplicateShows_one: {{count}} separate show matched to the same title
health.duplicateShows_other: {{count}} separate shows matched to the same title
health.duplicateMovies_one: {{count}} separate movie matched to the same title
health.duplicateMovies_other: {{count}} separate movies matched to the same title

libraryWork.followProgressOrStop: Follow progress or Stop in Activity. Completed changes are kept if stopped. Media files are never changed.
libraryWork.refreshDescription: Fetch online details again for every known movie or series in {{name}}, including recently refreshed titles. This can take time and make many provider requests. Locked edits and watch history are kept.
libraryWork.analyzeDescription: Read technical details again for all known present files in {{name}}, including HDR and audio format checks that were previously unavailable. This can keep the server busy. Matches, watch history and manual markers are kept; new files are found with Scan.

markerCoverage.whichTitlesHaveIntro: Shows which titles have intro and credits markers. Availability depends on library settings and chapter, provider or local-detection results.
